answer.reason: Greif makes industrial packaging (drums, IBCs, containerboard) and provides filling and reconditioning services. Ashland makes specialty chemical additives and ingredients such as cellulose derivatives, polymers and pharma excipients. Both are B2B global manufacturers, but the products differ and the customers' needs differ. Ashland's customers buy ingredients to put into their products, and Greif's buy containers to ship them in.
